demo (stand-in) → advance: Ran the real CLI offline with RUNPOD_API_KEY unset and an isolated ETUDE_HOME. Reads answered from the database: `etude status` (`last loop: never`) and `etude machines`. On a real local run, `etude logs --run RUN` printed retained evidence, `output not received; collected=None` per stream, `[snapshot incomplete]` and the `--follow` hint. After `etude wait`, the same keyless read showed the retained job stderr with `collected=` and `[snapshot complete]`. `terminate {machine}`, `rent {ondemand} --hours` and `availability {ondemand}` take their input positionally. `terminate --machine` is rejected, and `logs --timeout` without `--follow` is refused. The counting test test_reads_need_no_provider_key pins zero provider, bucket, SSH and git calls for every declared read. The demo job failed because the throwaway repo had no etude in its job environment; that is a fixture fault, not this change. Follow-up, not blocking: `last loop:` reflects only the controller daemon, so `status` said `never` after `wait` had advanced the run in-process. Record: scratch/demo-launcher-reads.md.
